values.note: 125 paved RV/tent sites along the Lake Greenwood shoreline, plus a primitive group area. Many sites take RVs up to 40 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-greenwood/camping ('125 paved sites may be used by both RVs and tents'; 'Many paved sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Park Wi-Fi reaches only the Drummond Center and the park office area, not the campgrounds.

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-greenwood/camping ('All sites are convenient to hot showers and restrooms'; 'Dump Station: Yes'; 'Wi-Fi is available only at the Drummond Center and the park office area. Wi-Fi service does not extend to any campground locations'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Minimum length of stay for advance reservations is 2 nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. 'Between April 1 and August 31, campers can stay a maximum of 14 nights at Lake Greenwood' and must then leave for 7 consecutive nights; any one reservation is at most 14 nights. Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/lake-greenwood/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; 'Between April 1 and August 31, campers can stay a maximum of 14 nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/lake-greenwood/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance. Minimum length of stay for advance reservations is 2 nights'; 'no longer than 14 nights'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver); added 50 A + water at all 125 sites up to 40 ft, 14-night max (Apr-Aug park limit), showers, dump, and no Wi-Fi at the campground. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. Not stated: sewer (the 10-12 fee note's 'full-service sites' are not described on the park page), season, pull-throughs.
